SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id
JOIN code.calls c ON s.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id
WHERE f.module = 'base'
  AND f.package = 'auto_ontology.connectors'
  AND s.kind = 'method'
  AND s.name = 'get_columns'
  AND s.is_public = FALSE
  AND f.is_test = FALSE
GROUP BY s.symbol_id
HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
  AND MAX(CASE WHEN c.resolution = 'same_file' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
  AND MAX(CASE WHEN c.confidence = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
  AND MAX(CASE WHEN h.value IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
  AND s.symbol_id NOT LIKE '%@L%'

request:
Among the production database connector classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase (auto_ontology/connectors/base.py), excluding classes in test code (any file under a tests/ folder), which ones override get_columns with their own get_columns method that has no docstring of its own (a leading # comment is not a docstring)? Return the symbol ID of each such get_columns method.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: The query joins the headings table with a condition on heading = 'get_columns' to check for a docstring value, using a LEFT JOIN so that symbols without a matching heading still appear in results. It filters for methods named get_columns in the base connector file, excludes test files and public symbols, groups by symbol_id, and applies having conditions to ensure exactly one same-file call site, no high-confidence resolution, and no docstring value.
sql:
SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id
JOIN code.calls c ON s.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id
LEFT JOIN code.headings h ON h.file_id = s.file_id AND h.heading = 'get_columns'
WHERE f.module = 'base'
  AND f.package = 'auto_ontology.connectors'
  AND s.kind = 'method'
  AND s.name = 'get_columns'
  AND s.is_public = FALSE
  AND f.is_test = FALSE
GROUP BY s.symbol_id
HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
  AND MAX(CASE WHEN c.resolution = 'same_file' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
  AND MAX(CASE WHEN c.confidence = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
  AND MAX(CASE WHEN h.value IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
  AND s.symbol_id NOT LIKE '%@L%'
